== Summary ==
Slip “Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can” cut unchanged from page 10 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (598, 75, 1110, 418)). Version [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can (V)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
